# Flute of the Soul

Flute of the Soul is the official portfolio and technical writing site of Apurv Chudasama (also known as Apurv), an AI Engineer in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Search aliases include “Apurv Chudasama AI Engineer”, “Apurv AI Engineer India”, and “Apurv Chudasama Ahmedabad”. The site covers production voice AI, agentic systems, LangGraph, retrieval-augmented generation, LLM evaluation, and applied machine learning.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage and portfolio](https://fluteofthesoul.dev/): Professional background, projects, skills, publications, and contact details.
- [Technical writing](https://fluteofthesoul.dev/#blogs): Articles on AI engineering, autonomous AI agents, RAG, LangGraph, model evaluation, and deployment.
- [XML sitemap](https://fluteofthesoul.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of all indexable articles.
